caption: A large hanging sheet of thin steel is struck once with a mallet, and waves ripple visibly across the metal as it booms.

sa.check: A large thin steel sheet hangs.
The strike is a single hit.
The strike comes first and the ripples follow.

pc.expect: Ripples spread out from the point of impact across the sheet.
pc.fail: The mallet lands and the sheet hangs flat and still; or the waves start at the far edge and travel toward the impact point; or the sheet ripples while the mallet is held away.

pc.expect: The ripples are strongest just after the strike and fade until the sheet hangs flat; they do not grow or restart.
pc.fail: The waves grow after the strike; or the sheet keeps waving unchanged to the end; or it goes flat and then starts waving again with no second strike; or it freezes in a bent shape.

pc.expect: The sheet hangs from its top and returns to hanging straight after any sway.
pc.fail: The sheet rises on its hanger; or hangs at an angle with nothing touching it; or its bottom edge lifts and stays out.

pc.expect: The thin steel flexes as a sheet and the mallet rebounds from it.
pc.fail: The mallet sinks into the sheet; or the sheet tears; or it crumples like foil and stays crumpled.

pc.expect: One sheet, one mallet; the mallet does not pass through the sheet.
pc.fail: A second sheet appears; or the mallet passes through the sheet; or the sheet vanishes; or splits into two.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sheet's colour, the hanger and the mallet stay the same.
pc.fail: The sheet changes colour; or the hanger changes; or the mallet's head changes size.

note: The hand on the mallet is a trigger and is not judged.
